title: cost-synthesis-validator-and-unwind-choreography
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a validator service that scores automated batching/caching config recommendations for semantic fidelity and regression risk, and coordinates a progressive unwind/rollback choreography when acceptance thresholds fail. Separate from existing probe suites, this work focuses on a compact, fast evaluation pass used in staged applies (shadow, canary, staggered apply) to reduce human review load while limiting risk to production quality.
summary: Automate quality gating for batch/cache cost recommendations using a lightweight golden-suite evaluation, multi-metric acceptance windowing, and an orchestrated unwind plan that can run without full human intervention for low-severity regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Validator API exposes /score-config (JSON) and returns: semantic_similarity_score, response_fidelity_delta, token_cost_delta, pass_fail_reason
Stratified golden-suite (50 prompts across 5 buckets) runs in < 90s for a candidate config against a baseline for canary lanes
Automated decision rules applied with explainable rationale (thresholds + confidence interval) and recorded in audit logs
Rollback choreography executes automatically for P0/P1 failures and produces a post-mortem artifact with diffs and the final decision
Integration tests covering shadow apply -> canary -> staged rollforward with synthetic traffic succeed in CI
decisions: Use embedding-based semantic similarity (cosine on model-agnostic embeddings) as primary fidelity metric, supplemented by token-level divergence and length-normalized edit distance for dialogs
Adopt a two-tier threshold: soft-warning (human audit recommended) and hard-fail (automatic unwind). Soft-warning triggers a paused canary and notify on-call; hard-fail triggers immediate rollback
Keep golden-suite intentionally small and stratified for speed; reserve full regression harness for nightly/weekly runs
Persist decision metadata to the console audit log and tag the model/config snapshot for potential investigation
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Initial spike completed — benchmarked embedding sim vs token-bleu on 3 reference workloads. Embedding sim gives better correlation with human judgments for conversational drift
2026-02-28: PoC validator service implemented (python microservice). Endpoints wired to shadow-apply runner. Latency for 50-prompt golden-suite: 72s on c4-small runner
2026-03-05: Integrations meeting with Console team — agreed on audit schema and event hooks (link to RFC in links)
2026-03-10: First canary staged apply executed in dev cluster. Validator flagged a soft-warning; human audit performed and approved after 2 moderator reviews
2026-03-12: Added CI tests for synthetic traffic replay; found a rare nondeterminism in caching TTL handling — created a follow-up bug ENG-772556
review_feedback: PM review (Sanjay Rao): prefer conservative soft-warning windows for enterprise customers — lowered soft threshold to reduce false negatives
Security (Lena Hu): require KMS-backed signing of validator decisions before auto-rollback execution — added signing step to rollout_plan
Design (Maya Chen): recommends clearer tooling UX for auditors to replay pre/post responses — linked to mockups in links
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring functions (embedding sim, token delta, edit distance)
E2E shadow -> canary -> staged apply runs against dev dataset with telemetry capture
A/B style statistical test in canary lanes: bootstrap confidence intervals for semantic similarity delta
Human-in-the-loop audits for 10% of soft-warning canaries to calibrate thresholds
Nightly full regression run against reference corpus (longer suite) to catch slow drift
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): validator runs in shadow apply only. No automatic rollbacks. (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (beta customers): enable soft-warning canaries with human audits and signed decision records. Auto-rollback disabled. (3 weeks)
Phase 3 (gradual enablement): enable hard-fail auto-unwind for non-critical routes in a single region with clear observability dashboards. (4 weeks)
Phase 4 (global): full auto-unwind with enterprise opt-out and extended audit retention
rollback_playbook: Hard-fail: immediately revert config to last known-good snapshot and mark incident as auto-unwind; notify on-call and create incident ticket with validator artifact
Soft-warning escalation: pause rollout, create audit request for reviewers, allow 24h for human decision; if no human decision, default to pause until manual resolution
Fallback strategy: if unwind fails, route traffic to model-variant fallback (lower-cost/high-stability) and open P0 incident
Post-rollback: capture diffs (pre/post prompts, outputs, scoring vectors) and attach to post-mortem
notes: We intentionally avoid training-time metrics; validator is model-agnostic and operates on request/response pairs
Consider adding a small human review budget for high-value customers to reduce false positives
Future work: integrate a lightweight hallucination detector into the fidelity score
